scope: source inspection of current authoring tree, not deployed runtime or visual/audio E2E

existing_components.actual_owner_outbox: produces source-qualified effects/projectiles/sounds with committed occurrence provenance; replay does not emit twice
existing_components.candidate_codec: closed bounded Effect/Missile/Words/Value/Sound shapes; does not register protocol transport
existing_components.candidate_publisher: VIS-2 observer qualification and candidate event encoding; only unit/qualification callers, no node egress caller

asset_manifest.scope: only the tracked pinned manifest; does not claim sound assets absent from owner computer

blockers.detail: PRESENTATION_V1, WORLD_PRESENTATION and ACTOR_COOLDOWNS absent from accepted registry. Local candidate framing explicitly grants no envelope route.
CandidatePresentationTurn/CandidateSessionPublisher are called by tests only; no serving-node presentation send route.
No consumer for spell_presentation_candidate in session/dev-client/client; native spell UI displays feedback and vitals only.
No audio playback dependency/path in native client; sound cues are numeric data, not audio asset closure. Tracked15.30 manifest has no sound payloads.
Publisher uses existing VIS-2 floors0..15; negative Thalom floors refused until an owning frame projection is qualified.
Candidate wire supports Words and Value, but actual committed cue owner only produces Effect/Projectile/Sound.

source_engine_sound_semantics.statement: Source sound handling skips silent cues; spell default cast is SPELL_OR_RUNE and default impact is SILENCE. Numeric 0 must not become an audible cue.

independent_registry_check.scope: all record source_enum values match exact pinned enum files and both file sha256 pins match git-show bytes; no gameplay/playback claim

cue_registry_repair.regression: original builder wrongly admitted effect/sound names from unrelated enums; repaired builder requires owning enum and actual Lua registration
